extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: (1) One row had a misspelled island name 'Bisco' which was corrected to 'Biscoe'; (2) The 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas (e.g., '2,900') and was successfully converted to numeric; (3) Three rows had body mass values in the millions of grams (e.g., 3,900,000), which are impossible and outside the valid range of 2500–6500 grams; these were excluded; (4) Two exact duplicate rows were removed. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 82,550 g, Chinstrap: 30,625 g, Gentoo: 54,125 g.
